=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note pass p (1..100) toggles every p-th door; afterwards print the open doors
fn main to int
d = new uchar 101 0
for k ulong 100
p = add k 1
i = p
while le i 100 bound 101
put d i xor get d i 1
i = add i p
end
end
f = true
for i ulong 101
if eq get d i 1
if not f
emit sp
end
emitu i
f = false
end
end
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
1 4 9 16 25 36 49 64 81 100
</pre>
